text:
leah: Heads-up 00: NovaCorp VRM returned the SIG and wants per-question evidence + a mapping CSV. Deadline Friday COB. Who can take sections?

vincent: Ill own infra/network and auth.

maya: I'll take encryption, keys, and logging. Will redact PII.

chris: I'll gather SOC2 certs and subprocessors list.

leah: Good. VRM expects artifacts as individual files per question. They ingest into Aravo. Please use s3://redwood-sig/nova/ with section/question-id/ layout. Pre-signed links ok, 7d expiry.

vincent: I'll produce topology.png, security-groups-export.json, and a short note for each question.

maya: For KMS I'm preparing key policies, rotation proof (redacted), and HSM attestation excerpt.

chris: I'll upload soc2-2024.pdf and subprocessors-2025-03.csv.

leah: Also need a residency statement for EU tenants. Tom in legal asked to draft that and attach.

vincent: Quick export command I'll run:
```
redwoodctl sig-export --customer nova --sections infra,auth --out s3://redwood-sig/nova/export-2025-03-25/
```

maya: I'll run redaction: `tools/redact --pii rotation.log > rotation-redacted.log` then upload.

chris: evidence-bot: please create initial mapping CSV placeholder.

evidence-bot: mapping stub created: s3://redwood-sig/nova/mapping/nova-sig-mapping-20250325.csv (:package:)

leah: Plan: owners upload artifacts by tomorrow 16:00 PT, I will assemble final CSV and send links to VRM.

vincent: Infra artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-sig/nova/infra/1.1/topology.png

maya: Uploaded redacted rotation logs: s3://redwood-sig/nova/crypto/2.1/rotation-redacted.log

chris: SOC2 and subprocessors uploaded.

leah: Great. I'll generate presigned links and email Nova VRM with mapping + invite for 30m walkthrough post-ingest.

vincent: Can we do walkthrough next Tue morning CET?

maya: I can join.

leah: Thanks team 44d. Leave a note here for any late uploads or legal questions.

evidence-bot: presigned links generated: s3://redwood-sig/nova/presigned/nova-presigned-20250325.txt
